subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**with**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, "education" and its importance has been discussed.
 
• Now, in blank 5, a preposition will fill the blank to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• **With the verb "communicate" we can use "with" to introduce the receiver of the communication or some noun describing the act of communicating.**
 
• In blank 5 the word "with" will complete the meaning of the verb "communicate."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**
